concept.reason: Actual full mounted specimen photograph and primary redescription support original target; no extra concept generation.

scope: Whole animal reconstruction with long high dorsal sail and elongated beaked head; not skeleton, partial torso or unrelated sail-backed taxon.

scientific_limits.en: Living artistic reconstruction, not scan. Seven metres is a conventional scale estimate, not complete adult specimen measurement. MSNVE3714 is partly restored, immature and lacks tail tip; its mounted skull is restored. Tissue thickness around tall spines, colour and pose are inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体美术复原，非化石扫描。7米为约定估算尺度，非完整成年标本实测。MSNVE3714未成熟，含补配且缺尾尖，装架头骨为复原。高棘外软组织厚度、颜色和姿态不确定。

scale.basis: Historical holotype estimate cited in2017redescription; complete adult length unknown. Tail tip extrapolated, not measured.

diagnostic_targets: Long tall continuous dorsal profile extends from back across sacrum onto proximal tail, with higher dorsal and lower sacral rise rather than a single triangular fin.
Elongated low broad-ended beaked head, modest paired nasal bulges; no theropod jaws or cranial horn.
Deep herbivorous trunk, shorter forelimbs and strong hindlimbs, long tapering tail retained.
Sail is covered soft tissue around neural spines, not exposed bone bars, separate plates, or an invented camel hump.
Small hands remain conservative because complete manus is not preserved; no exaggerated Iguanodon thumb weapons.
specimen_basis: MSNVE3714 official MUVE mounted specimen photograph personally inspected.2017 Bertozzo etal redescription distinguishes restored skull and missing bones; no claim of viewing inaccessible Fig3.
acceptance_checks: Side clearly reads long high dorsal sail with posterior lower rise and elongated beaked skull.
Whole organism four limbs, complete tapering tail; soft tissue crest not skeleton bars.
Avoid sail-less Iguanodon substitution, spinosaur jaws and generic single triangular fin.
Standard four views only; perspective may reuse preview bytes; no unsupported website renderer equivalence.
